name: preferences-save-and-recall
description:
The user asks for German replies; the agent saves the preference (one confirm card), and a later turn's get_preferences returns the saved value from durable storage — recall exercised on a separate turn so a per-turn re-grant cannot fake persistence.

Each user turn is three LLM steps, not one: after respond_to_user the runner makes one more model call carrying that tool's own result, and only the model's agent_work_complete actually ends the turn — mirrors slot-approval-binds-one-company's documented shape for the same reason: fewer surprises about what a given Send actually carries.
userTurns: please reply in German from now on

reply.text: Gespeichert — I will reply in German.
